record.edic_text:
3014 lepra {lep'-rah}

from the same as 3013; TDNT - 4:233,529; n f

AV - leprosy 4; 4

1) leprosy
2) a most offensive, annoying, dangerous, cutaneous disease, the
   virus of which generally pervades the whole body, common in Egypt
   and the East
